batch_node.name: Gridkin fixture — OCC update
batch_node.description: Replaces the OCC Demo Node with envelope-declared entity_expected_version=2. The seed fixture's create lands the entity at version=2 (GRIFT's prespecified-id create path: Entity.objects.create produces version=1, then BaseModel.save's spine sync bumps to 2). This fixture's replace must observe version=2 and bump to 3. If the OCC machinery regresses (version check skipped, declared-on-missing rule broken, etc.) this fixture fails to import and the scenario fails before the query runs.
